nativeTheme.light: Cobalt lightColorScheme; explicit tokens in DESIGN.md
nativeTheme.dark: Cobalt darkColorScheme; explicit tokens in DESIGN.md
nativeTheme.palettePolicy: User-approved fixed Cobalt scheme through semantic Material 3 roles; system light/dark selection.

extensions.elevation: Default zero-elevation Surface; tonal hierarchy through surfaceContainerHigh.
extensions.nativeRendering: Jetpack Compose and Android vectors are authoritative. No HTML/CSS approximations.
accessibility: Scrollable body and wrapping titles support system font scaling.
Refresh is a 48dp target; count and calendar-access controls have 48dp minimum height.
Refresh has a content description; count exposes event labels and native selected semantics.

launcher.description: White calendar outline and right arrow on Cobalt primary background; 108-unit viewport, rounded 4-unit calendar and 4.5-unit arrow strokes; also used as adaptive monochrome foreground.

walking.setup: Scrollable Material AlertDialog, password field, SecureOn screenshots; local key entry

components.name: Refresh
components.description: FilledTonalIconButton with disabled loading indicator; manual refresh completion shows Agenda updated or failure snackbar.

components.name: Featured event
components.description: Tonal Surface with headline, absolute time and relative time; 220ms crossfade when the featured event changes.

components.name: Later event
components.description: Aligned clock/content row with inset dividers.

components.name: Event count
components.description: SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow with five numeric choices; 180ms selection-color transition.

components.name: Agenda message
components.description: Tonal state surface with optional FilledTonalButton recovery.

narrative.overview: NextUp is a quiet, compact Android utility. Native Material 3 typography, the approved Cobalt palette and restrained tonal surfaces make calendar content easy to scan.
dos: Do use native Material color and typography roles in both themes.
Do retain full titles, accessible labels and scrollable large text.
Do use actual calendar content to establish hierarchy.
donts: Don't introduce decorative imagery, gradients or custom shadows.
Don't add navigation or extra settings to this single-screen utility.
